messages:
Maya (Support): FYI — multiple customers reporting per-model throughput tiles in Console are showing flat 0 QPS since ~2026-03-16 20:05 UTC. Tickets include screenshots; they think inference stopped.

Ava (Customer Success): A few customers are pretty worried. "Tiles look dead" and asking for ETA. No errors reported from their API logs.

Chris (Eng-Platform): Can someone paste a dashboard link + one example model id? Any exporter or metrics change in last 24h?

Maya (Support): Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/tiles/per-model-throughput
Example model shown: rwd-chatlite-4

Devon (Eng-SRE): We rolled exporter v3.0 yesterday; it replaced label `model` with `model_handle` to standardize naming. It was intended to be additive, but the build inadvertently dropped the old `model` label.

Maya (Support): That would explain it — many panels still query `by (model)`. How can we quickly confirm from prod?

Devon (Eng-SRE): Quick verification steps anyone can run:
1) curl metrics from an exporter pod: `curl -s http://exporter:9100/metrics | grep redwood_model_qps | head -n 5`
2) Prom query panels use: `sum(rate(redwood_model_qps[5m])) by (model)` -> returns no series / 0
3) Query with new label: `sum(rate(redwood_model_qps[5m])) by (model_handle)` -> returns expected series and values

Chris (Eng-Platform): Confirmed on staging — Prometheus only has `model_handle` label. Grafana panels still use `model`, so they render blank.

Maya (Support): Customers need reassurance and an ETA. Is there a fast mitigation to restore visuals without editing thousands of dashboards?

Devon (Eng-SRE): Short-term mitigation: add a metric_relabel_configs entry in the scrape job to copy `model_handle` -> `model` so existing queries keep working. Example we tested in staging:

```
metric_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [model_handle]
    target_label: model
    action: replace
    regex: (.+)
    replacement: "$1"
```
Then POST to Prometheus `/-/reload`. I applied the relabel to prod scrape job a few minutes ago.

ci-bot: prometheus/prod-config reloaded by Devon — commit 9f2b41c

Chris (Eng-Platform): I validated panels repopulated. `sum by (model) (rate(redwood_model_qps[5m]))` shows rwd-chatlite-4 and other models again.

Ava (Customer Success): Passing this to customers now: "Visualisation mismatch; inference traffic unaffected. Short-term shim added; working on permanent fix." :white_check_mark:

Maya (Support): Customers asked for root cause and next steps.

Devon (Eng-SRE): Root cause: exporter release removed legacy `model` label. Plan:
- Immediate: Prom relabel shim to regenerate `model` from `model_handle` (done)
- Medium: release exporter patch that emits both `model` and `model_handle` for backcompat
- Long-term: update dashboards and any alert rules to use canonical `model_handle` label and retire `model`
We'll keep the relabel shim for a migration window (48h) while we push the backcompat patch and sweep dashboards.

Chris (Eng-Platform): I'll create a migration ticket to update dashboards & alerting rules to `model_handle`, assign owners, and schedule a small Grafana update window. Ticket: PLAT-6910.

Devon (Eng-SRE): Opened PR #459 to restore `model` emission (map from `model_handle`) — requested fast-track review.

Maya (Support): Any chance internal monitors paged customers or our SREs? I saw a couple of internal alerts about zero throughput.

Chris (Eng-Platform): Internal synthetic rule `tiles-no-data` used `by (model)` and fired. I silenced the rule and will switch it to `model_handle` in the alert definition, then un-silence. Silenced until EOD UTC.

Ava (Customer Success): I'll update affected customers with the timeline and escalation contact. Please ping when the exporter patch is in prod so I can close the support tickets.

Devon (Eng-SRE): Timeline:
- +0m: prom relabel applied (done)
- +30-90m: exporter backcompat release (PR in review)
- +24-48h: dashboards & alerts migrated to `model_handle`, then remove relabel shim
I'll post updates here as steps complete.

Devon (Eng-SRE): PR #459 merged and staged; release initiated.

ci-bot: exporter-v3.0.1 deployed to prod — build 3a7d2e

Chris (Eng-Platform): Confirmed dashboards remain populated after release. Leaving relabel in place until we finish dashboard sweeps and owners confirm.

Ava (Customer Success): Thanks — notifying customers with the final note and expected removal window for the relabel shim.

Maya (Support): Marking escalated -> mitigated for now. Will keep open until exporter backcompat and dashboard migration complete.

Maya (Support): Thanks all :pray:
